summary.intent: Run the Nyquist validation gate for Phase 66 (API schema cutover) to audit test coverage and fill any gaps before shipping.
summary.outcome: A focused claim-path spec (9 tests, all green) was authored by the nyquist auditor subagent, covering the security-critical T-66-E1 invariant and 5 other invariants. VALIDATION.md was updated to nyquist_compliant: true and both files were committed.

repo: The entire shares module unit specs were deleted during the descriptor-ref cutover and never rewritten — only the new claim-path spec was added back.
The publish plane (TEE-04/05/07, WRITE-04, DATA-03) had strong coverage: 174 ipns unit tests + 5 e2e tests.
DATA-02 (descriptor-ref grant/claim/revoke) and DATA-04 (revoke path) were uncovered prior to this session.
T-66-E1 fix: read-only invite must not propagate a writeDescriptorRef even if the claimer's DTO supplies one — validated by asserting toBeNull() in the new spec.

code.finding: New spec covering 6 invariants (9 test cases): T-66-E1 read-only invite blocks write grant, write invite propagates claimer ref, root identity from invite row, self-claim rejection, expired/non-active invite (4 sub-cases), idempotent re-claim.

workflow: After a subagent fills gaps, adversarially verify: check no impl files were touched and run the spec independently before accepting results.
When the validate-phase hook is not active in config, the gate can still be run directly if ship-phase requires it.
Deferred broader coverage gaps should be captured as explicit todos in .planning/todos/pending/ rather than left implicit.

friction: No active validate-phase enforcement hook was configured in settings, requiring manual judgment to proceed rather than automatic enforcement.
The broader shares/bin unit suite deletion was a silent regression — no CI signal until the gap analysis surfaced it.
open_items: Restore full shares module unit coverage: the broader shares/bin suite rewrite was deferred as a todo (2026-06-30-restore-shares-module-unit-coverage.md).
DATA-04 revoke path remains without dedicated unit tests beyond the claim-path spec.
PR body was drafted with a validation placeholder — needs finalization after ship gate.
